evidence: Modifies address management filtering in AddrMan::GetAddr_() and updates addrman fuzz tests.
rationale: Fixes an inconsistency where AddrMan::GetAddr_() filtered linked-IPv4 addresses as IPv4 while AddrMan::Size() counted them as IPv6. The PR description notes that commit faa7ba3103 adds an addrman fuzz test asserting that network filtering agrees with network counts, which asserts on unfixed code, but netgroup bucketing remains untouched so peer selection security is unaffected.
